description: Executable Pending single-Spark OpenAI-compatible text-and-image recipe for Meta Muse Glimmer 30B BF16, using the official vLLM 0.30.0 ARM64 release image and immutable local media inputs. Chat, vision, reasoning, and tool calling remain Candidate capabilities; combining reasoning with JSON-schema structured output is not supported by this pinned runtime. GB10 memory correction: Per-node peak budgets utilization × 130,663,231,488-byte unified memory plus at least 8 GB for CUDA context/graphs, FlashInfer workspace, auxiliary heads and CPU/mmap buffers; 8 GB reserve, with a separate 6 GB OS floor. This is a conservative budget, not a measured footprint.
title: Muse Glimmer 30B BF16 vLLM single Spark
